register_stadiamaps("824e1e2a-26b0-4511-874e-b93a502f5dce", write = FALSE)
insects%>%
  select(point_x, point_y)%>%
  summary()
##     point_x           point_y       
##  Min.   :3525643   Min.   :5282797  
##  1st Qu.:3623496   1st Qu.:5379712  
##  Median :3678768   Median :5510022  
##  Mean   :3677620   Mean   :5459088  
##  3rd Qu.:3721481   3rd Qu.:5536414  
##  Max.   :3834635   Max.   :5582171

point_x: Longitude of the study plot, coordinate system as “ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N”. point_y: Latitude of the study plot, coordinate system as “ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N”. ##NOT IN LONGITUDE/LATITUDE, needs to be translated :(

df<- data.frame(
  plot_id = c("A", "B"),
  point_x = c(3525643, 3834635),
  point_y = c(5282797, 5582171)
)
pts<- st_as_sf(df, coords = c("point_x", "point_y"), crs = 25832)

pts_11<- st_transform(pts, 4326)
st_coordinates(pts_11)
##             X        Y
## [1,] 45.14208 41.56423
## [2,] 49.57366 42.51977
pts_11<- st_transform(pts, 4326)
plot(pts_11)

X Y [1,] 45.14208 41.56423 [2,] 49.57366 42.51977

lat<- c(45.14208, 41.56423 )
long<- c(49.57366, 42.51977)
bbox<- make_bbox(long, lat, f=0.05)

#map of where the data came from (hopefully)

map1<- get_stadiamap(bbox, maptype = "stamen_terrain", zoom = 5)
## ℹ © Stadia Maps © Stamen Design © OpenMapTiles © OpenStreetMap contributors.
ggmap(map1)

ggmap(map1)+
  geom_point(data = insects, aes(point_x, point_y), size = 0.5, color = "black", alpha= 0.8)+
  labs(x= "longitude",
       y= "latitude",
       title = "insect")
